properties.name: The two oversized subsystems gain a functional rung
properties.rationale:
Anthony's word, 2026-08-25, on a grouping put to him with alternatives.

THE QUALITY TARGET PICKED THE CUT, six hours after being settled. `dec:reflow2-is-built-for-observability` wants the INSTRUMENT SEPARATED FROM THE SUBJECT, and that is exactly the Finding/Telling split: a part that finds a problem must not be the part deciding how loudly to report it. Without that target the grouping would have been taste.

TWO GROUPS BREAK THE BAND ON PURPOSE, argued rather than apologised for. Tool surface stays at 12 on his explicit word, because those slices are already a partition of ONE surface and splitting them to reach 7 would use span of control as a GENERATOR. Install is a subsystem of ONE because it is the only part that writes into a repository that is not reflow2's own.

THE LADDER HAD NO ROOM between subsystem and component, so either 53 modules were demoted to `part` or 2 containers promoted to `system`. Promotion preserves what every existing node means and changes 2 levels instead of 53. The cost is a mixed top tier of 8 subsystems and 2 systems, honest because these two hold 84 and 49 of 211 capabilities.

THE LEAF FILTER FROM #336 PROVED ITSELF ON A REAL CHANGE. Adding 10 grouping components left `unallocated_component` at 33 of 85 leaves rather than jumping to 43, because parents are excluded. That exclusion was a judgement measured at 40-vs-33 when it shipped; a real structural change has now shown it prevents a false alarm.

MEASURED AFTERWARDS AND REPORTED HONESTLY: only 20 percent of component dependencies with both ends inside the split systems fall WITHIN a group; 80 percent cross. That does not validate the grouping by a modularity standard and was never going to. The dependency graph is a star, 57 of 72 edges reach outside the split systems, and the dominant cross-edge is Telling depending on Finding, a DIRECTED LAYER dependency that is the observability cut working rather than failing. Same disagreement the 2026-08-21 co-change experiment found at 71 percent.

SURFACED RATHER THAN CREATED: `cmp:claims` and `cmp:operate` may not belong in the coherence loop, and `sys:foundation` at 10 children is still over the band.
properties.subject: record
properties.summary: Split sys:coherence-loop (28 children) and sys:agent-surface (25) into 5 functional groups each: 10 new subsystem nodes, 53 components moved with move_component, both containers promoted to `system`. 95 to 105 components; depth {1:13,2:80,3:2} became {1:13,2:37,3:55}; span-of-control violations 3 to 2; hierarchy_issues 0, multiple_parents 0.
